question: Why is Durga identified as both the mother of the world and the liberator from the cycle of birth?
premises: She is called the mother of the world
She is called the liberator from birth and transmigration
inference: Durga unites the roles of cosmic origin and release from rebirth.
plain_english: You are Durga, the mother of the world and the liberator from the cycle of birth and transmigration.
